annotations.title: Inspect saved Entity MIS numerical coverage

description: Inspect canonical current Entity MIS numerical coverage for the run_id returned by current-run discovery for the requested reporting period. Superseded versions are not accessible. The returned version is a source citation, not a selector. If source_changed is returned, rediscover the current run and restart at page 1. Reviewed codecs cover ordinary Entity financial statement populations returned by this catalogue, cumulative_variance_tracking year-to-date profit after tax and services_lockup detail populations contract_lockup_v5 and customer_lockup_v5 plus its services_lockup visual population and the additional reviewed native V5 detail and visual populations returned by this catalogue. The catalogue also admits four reviewed legacy business detail populations: inventory_aging/v4_aging_bucket, cohort_retention/v3_cohort_cell, churn_reasons/v3_churn_reason and at_risk_customers/v5_at_risk_raw_summary; recovery/editor and opaque-reference workflows are excluded. The current catalogue additionally admits shared statement candidates across twelve report families, including Services, Schools and statutory summaries, conditional on actual current saved availability. Statutory facts identify authenticated saved-row occurrences, not V2 identities or distinct economic totals; never deduplicate or aggregate equal-looking rows. Excluded rows without typed amounts/counts retain state and a context gap, never values parsed from prose. Native comparisons within a current report are current output. Native headlines and period_highlights are scalar candidates with key equal to report_id; saved claims and five Headlines counts are qualified on read, not reconstructed from their source reports. Scalar admission does not establish saved body availability or whole-MIS coverage. Typed and visual catalogue entries require body qualification on each read: materialized:null and sourceState:pending_qualification mean materialization is unknown, not absent or already qualified. Other native report families are unfinished coverage, not native numerical unavailability. Group readers are still being added. Codec support does not establish complete semantic meaning: retain semantic_meaning_not_qualified gaps and withheld display labels from each read. Never infer complete MIS coverage from this catalogue or reconstruct missing native metrics.
